scene: Warm steam clears to reveal a hidden transit junction beneath the street.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along a subterranean tile platform. On the left, a green tram wrapped in flowering vines rests at a wooden platform. At centre, the grandfather holds his bicycle beside a streamlined red bento-box train. On the right, a giant painted koi boat bobs against a stone dock with its gangplank down.
shown: a mossy open-air tram car with leafy railings waiting on tracks at the left
a sleek train shaped like a lacquered lunchbox idling at the platform centre
a carved wooden koi-shaped canal boat floating in blue water on the right
